verdict.rationale: Dover documents its own AI-powered applicant scoring, which gives each applicant a 0–100 score so recruiters can review the strongest candidates first. That covers the core AI screening and matching capability. The evidence does not explain how the score is derived or describe any safeguards on automated decisions; the EEO survey and reporting are adjacent and not AI-decision safeguards. missing for 10: documentation of how the scoring model works, documented safeguards for automated decisions (bias auditing, human-review requirements, candidate notice), independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a recruiter, AI helps screen and match candidates against the role — with the vendor documenting how it works and what safeguards apply to automated decisions

citations.quote: Each applicant gets a score from 0 to 100, so you can review your strongest candidates first.
